title: The Baltic Way
voice: platform TTS (add_voice + generate_speech, American English narrator); fallback: Kokoro-82M on GitHub

paragraphs.text: On the evening of August twenty-third, nineteen eighty-nine, two million people joined hands and drew a living line across three nations the Soviet Union had swallowed.

Fifty years earlier, to the day, Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union had signed a pact with a secret protocol that split Eastern Europe between them. In August nineteen forty, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania were annexed.
On the pact's fiftieth anniversary, they answered with a human chain six hundred seventy-five kilometers long, from Tallinn, through Riga, to Vilnius. For fifteen minutes, they held the line.
Less than seven months later, Lithuania became the first Soviet republic to declare independence. Estonia and Latvia followed in August nineteen ninety-one, as a failed coup shook Moscow.
On September sixth, nineteen ninety-one, Moscow recognized all three. Three flags were back on the map of Europe.
